scope: Additional real-Blender evaluated-vertex measurements and, when installed, frozen-word field-packet checks. No rendering, movie playback, audio listening or whole-frame image recognition.

thresholdDefinitions.rows2and3: >=25% for complete compass mechanism, ground excluded. Blade-only width is also separately recorded without a made-up threshold.
thresholdDefinitions.row8: Both compass-mechanism and blade-only widths recorded; no numerical minimum invented.
thresholdDefinitions.row39: >=30% for rod+cloth and for pile body+terminals; pile with supports is separately measured. No hands/base/charge dots counted.
thresholdDefinitions.row1: >=45% for table alone, no cloth or peeking foot.

sampling: Fractions .08/.50/.92 of rows2/3/8/39; row1 midpoint; word starts/ends and inactive gaps for optional field packets. This is not a per-frame minimum-width proof.
